2021-020                             PURPOSE: To clarify 1RCNY §4000-01 in relation to 2011 NYC Electrical
                                              Code Section 110.2(B), regarding electrical installations
                                              1000kVA or greater, and installations above 600V, which are
                                              required to be filed for Electrical Review.
 TECHNICAL
                                  SUBJECT(S): 1000 Kilo-Volt Amperes Equipment, Installations above
                                              1000kVA, Electrical Advisory Board, Electrical Plan
ISSUANCE DATE                                 Examination, Service Equipment, Transformers, UPS,
 October 7, 2021                              Generator, Installation above 600V.




    I.   BACKGROUND
         1 RCNY §4000-01 became effective on July 11, 2019 and addresses electrical work review. This
         Bulletin clarifies that 1 RCNY §4000-01 (a)(1) does not amend Section 110.2(B) of the 2011 NYC
         Electrical Code with regard to installations requiring electrical review. Further, this Bulletin clarifies
         the term other source as used in Section 110.2(B) of the 2011 NYC Electrical Code.


   II.   ELECTRICAL WORK SUBJECT TO ELECTRICAL REVIEW
         Electrical installations as described in Section 110.2(B) of the 2011 NYC Electrical Code are
         subject to electrical review. Section 110.2(B) requires that no electrical installation, subject to
         electrical review, be constructed prior to electrical review approval.

         Section 110.2(B) of the 2011 NYC Electrical Code requires that electrical installations of equipment
         totaling 1000 Kilo-Volts Amperes (kVA) or greater, or any electrical installation above 600 Volts, be
         approved by the Department. This same section describes electrical installation as follows:
         For the purpose of this section an electrical “installation” shall refer to the installation of service
         equipment, transformers, UPS systems, generators, electrical wiring of assembled photovoltaic
         arrays, generator paralleling equipment or other sources.

         While 1 RCNY §4000-01(a)(1) uses the term service with regards to electrical installations this
         section is not intended to limit the scope of electrical reviews required by Section 110.2 (B) of the
         2011 NYC Electrical Code.

         The term other sources in section 110.2(B) shall include but not be limited to the following: Energy
         Storage Systems, Fuel Cells, Photovoltaic Systems, DC or AC Micro Grids, Co-generation Plants,
         and Stationary Batteries.


  III.   FILING OF ELECTRICAL WORK SUBJECT TO ELECTRICAL REVIEW
         1 RCNY §4000-01(b) sets forth the filing requirements for electrical work subject to electrical review
         described in Section II of this Building Bulletin.
